text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Primary Biliary Cholangitis (PBC) with superimposed Hepatitis C infection. While PBC typically affects older females, your demographic and history of ulcerative colitis are atypical but possible; however, the specific combination of severe pruritus, fatigue, and the positive serologies (specifically Anti-mitochondrial antibodies if elevated) points strongly toward an autoimmune cholestatic process, while your sexual history necessitates ruling out Hepatitis B and C as the primary cause or a co-infection.
